task: Welcome to another exciting round of TextWorld! Here is how to play! First thing I need you to do is to make an effort to venture south. Then, pick up the Canadian passkey from the floor of the lounge. And then, unlock the Canadian chest in the lounge with the Canadian passkey. And then, open the Canadian chest. And then, pick up the formless passkey from the Canadian chest. Then, unlock the formless hatch. And then, open the formless hatch inside the lounge. After that, move east. And then, make an attempt to go to the south. Next, try to venture east. Once you do that, go to the east. Then, make an effort to head north. And then, attempt to take a trip west. Then, try to go to the north. If you can manage that, make an effort to take a trip north. And then, venture north. If you can accomplish that, venture east. That done, attempt to go south. Once you manage that, go south. With that over with, pick-up the latchkey from the floor of the bedroom. And once you've done that, you win!
